StringData.data: Recruiting Masters
You can recruit Masters with SOL once you have met their prerequisites.
Assign Representative Master
You can change which Master represents you on the Bridge by clicking Representative Master on their profile screen.

Each Master has their own Attunement that influences their damage and resistance to damage.
{color:#CD4B4B}Ardent{color:end}:
 15% damage increase against Helix Attunements, 15% damage decrease against Kinetic Attunements

{color:#73AF11}Helix{color:end}:
15% damage increase against Kinetic Attunements, 15% damage decrease against Ardent Attunements

{color:#266AC9}Kinetic{color:end}:
15% damage increase against Ardent Attunements, 15% damage decrease against Helix Attunements.
Choosing Skills
You can assign skills to hotkeys from the Skill Tab of the Master window (P).\nYou can also set up skills in the dispatch room.
Upgrading Skills (Missions)
Upgrading Skills (PvP)
Smart Casts

By using Smart Casts, skills will immediately cast at the mouse cursor. Select the skills you want to use in the Master Window [P] or select the Ultimate Gauge, and a settings button for Smart Casts will appear on the top right-side of the skill info window. Click this button to turn on Smart Casts or turn it off again. If you press Ctrl or Alt in battle, the Smart Casts button will appear above the skill icon.
Weapon Augments
All Masters each have 3 weapon upgrades that can be selected from either the Master window (P) or the lobby.
Augmenting Weapons
Each Augment can be upgraded up to level 3.\nAugments require upgrading material, which can be acquired through missions or PvP.
Types of Nodes

There are offensive, defensive and auxiliary Nodes.\nEach Master has a Node efficiency rate that determines the percentage of bonuses you gain from Nodes. If you fit the correct Node types to the correct slots, you will gain 100% of the bonuses from all Nodes.
Node Quality
Node quality is divided into 5 tiers. Common, Standard, Superior, Rare, and Legendary.
Equipping Nodes
You can equip/remove Nodes by opening the Node Tab in the Master window (P).
Master Nodes

Two Master Node pages are given initially and additional pages can be purchased using EL. Master Node pages are shared by all of your Masters.
{color:#ECCE58}Tip. You can use GOLD for the initial purchase.{color:end}
Support Kit

Tired of listening to someone else’s music? Then pop a coin in the Jukebox and make your selection! Then jam out to your favorite song with everyone on the bridge. The Jukebox only takes {color:#FFBB00}Jukebox Coins{color:end}.
{color:#ECCE58}Tip:{color:#FFBB00} Jukebox Coins{color:#ECCE58} can be purchased in the X-Coin Shop.{color:end}
Unlocking achievements will make cetain Masters available for recruitment, earn you titles, and open up side stories.
Mission Records

You can view the stage records tab and available challenges in the History window (U).\nAchieving ranks, eliminating rare monsters, and completing challenges will earn you various rewards, including X-Coin and GOLD!
Arena Record
You can check the results for your 10 most recent games for each Arena or Master game mode in the Arena Record window ([).
You can check your rankings, win/losses ratio, and scores.
Record Summary
You can check your recent achievements and mission records.

You can check on your contacts by viewing your Friends List.
Click Add Friend and enter a player's name to add them as a friend.
You can check who you have blocked in the Blocked Players List.
Blocked players cannot chat with you or send invites or messages to you.

You can check the Players List to view the players you have played against in the Recent Play List.

You can hire your friends as mercenaries from your Friends List.
You are able to hire that mercenary's Representative Master as one of your usable Masters on a Mission.
The friend that lent you a mercenary will receive a reward through the mail.
You cannot hire mercenaries in PvP.
Enjoy playing MXM alongside your favorite Masters! Form a community and flaunt your prestigious Guild Tag.
Create Guild / Disband

Guild Creation: Open the Guild Window by using the Shortcut Key (G). You may also speak with Marcus Gray, the Guild Manager. Guild creation requires a fee to initiate.

Disband: You can disband your guild from the Guild Management tab on the Guild Window by pressing the Disband Guild button.

{color:#C96B7A}Guilds may only be disbanded by the Guild Master after there are no remaining guild members.
Join Guild / Withdraw

Joining a Guild: You can join a guild after receiving an invitation from a Guild Master or Member.\nWithdraw: You can withdraw from your guild from the Guild Management tab on the Guild Window by pressing the Withdraw button.
Guild Chat Room
A Guild Chat Room is automatically created when creating or joining a guild.\nGuild memebers can freely communicate on the bridge.\nUse the shortcut key (g) to change the chat room.
Chat Commands

/Common : Chat to others on the bridge.
/Whisper "ID"
/Guild : Change to your Guild chat.
/All : Chat can be viewed by both friend and foe. (Arena only)
/Help : View help.
/Command : /View commands list.
/"Add Friend "ID"
/Remove Friend "ID"
Chat Room
You can create a Chat Room by clicking the "Create" button on the top of the Chat Window.
Advanced Settings
You can click on the cogwheel icon of the Chat Window to customize font sizes, block inappropriate language, and to enable a time stamp option.
There are five mission stages: Caligo, Lacrimosa, Rentu, Karith, and Nuuran.
Random Mission
Selects a mission stage at random.
Timespace Distortion

A special stage that remains open for a limited time that offers normal and extreme modes. Invite other Masters and take this opportunity to test their mettle!\n\n{color:#ECCE58}Tip: don't forget to check the Schedule Chart (;) for when the Timespace Distortion is open!{color:end}
Combat Arena
Take on the enemy team in a 3v3 deathmatch!\nThe team with the most points at the end of the match wins. One point is awarded for each kill.
Titan Ruins

Fight alongside ancient Titans in the Titan Ruins!
The team that destroys the opposing team's Core wins.
Obtain powerful buffs from Wardens and Keepers in the jungle.
Summon massive Titans to launch an assault on the enemy base.
Capture Altars on the top and bottom sides of the map to summon fallen heroes to aid you.
Collect 10 Titan Shards and transform into a Titan Incarnate.
Dominate the battlefield and secure victory!
Master Mini Games
Exhilarating Master Mini Games where you can play themed matches!\nThere are 9 activities from which one will be selected at random.\nMasters are also selected at random. Be prepared for anything!

You can change your title by opening the Title / Insignia (K) Window.
You can select different titles among those you've unlocked through achievements. You can select one to display, and another to get stat bonuses from.

{color:#C96B7A}Careful! Not all title effects are available in all arenas.
You can set insignia by opening the Title / Insignia (K) Window.\nYou can acquire by obtaining mission points or reach the tier at Ranked Mode.
